title: Reviewed gauge-topology decisions
description: One reviewed answer per revenue circle to the question of whether its gauge sits on water that reaches it. The only path in this project that can mark a gauge mapping reviewed.

decision.description: no_suitable_gauge_exists is a first-class outcome, not a failure to decide.

primary_gauge.description: Required for reassign and must name a reporting station in the CWC reference. Forbidden for no_suitable_gauge_exists. Optional for keep, where it may only repeat the gauge already assigned.

basis.description: The river relationship in one line, as it will be shown as the mapping basis.

decision_reasoning.description: Why, in the reviewer's own words. Kept so the decision can be re-examined without re-deriving it.

reviewer_qualification.description: Recorded verbatim. Never write up river knowledge as a hydrologist sign-off.

reviewed_at.description: ISO date the decision was made.
